jsonOptions.prompt: Extract only assertions explicitly present in this notice into JSON fields source_record_id, agency, body_event_type, filing_date, filing_time, timezone_text, withdrawal_target, withdrawal_scope, comment_close, hearing_date, effective_date, evidence_quotes. Use null for absent dates or timezone. Keep filing separate from effective dates and planned future filings. Include verbatim evidence quotes. Do not infer deadlines.
